summary: This lecture from Zadul-Ma'ad (Provisions for the Hereafter) Part 121 by Sheikh Ali Mashhour focuses on the character traits and etiquette (Shemael) of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The discussion covers the Prophet's generosity, especially during Ramadan when he would meet with Jibril, his physical appearance, gentleness, maturity, and his exceptional character when living with others. The lecture explains that his courage extended beyond physical bravery to include accepting counsel from subordinates, vulnerability, and sincerity—presenting himself authentically rather than maintaining a false facade.
suggested_title: The Character Traits of Prophet Muhammad: Generosity, Humility, and Courage
catchy_title: Why the Prophet's True Character Emerged Behind Closed Doors
